raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`validate_deepseek_v41_features` rejects every DeepSeek-V4.1 PD deployment that runs DSpark unless `--disaggregation-transfer-backend mooncake` (added in #38798 without a stated reason). On GKE A4X (GB300, RoCE over DRA-attached ConnectX-8 rails) Mooncake's RDMA path fails on every device pair ("Local-side RDMA failure detected", same rail included), while NIXL is the transport every SGLang PD deployment on that platform runs. The check therefore blocks DSV4.1 PD there entirely, and dropping DSpark to get past it costs the speculative decoding.

## Modifications

The transport clause of the check accepts `nixl` as well as `mooncake`; the static-verify, prefill-CP, attn-CP and DCP clauses and the rest of the message are unchanged. No transfer code changes: the DSpark aux (first token, draft state, hidden states) goes through the prefill-side aux WRITE path in `disaggregation/common` that both backends implement, and the NIXL connector already tracks aux/state notifications per component.

Adds `test/registered/unit/server_args/test_dsv41_dspark_pd_transport.py` (CPU): `nixl` and `mooncake` pass, another backend still raises.

## Accuracy Tests

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 1P1D (prefill TP4 + decode TP4, DSpark block size 3, static verify, NIXL with GPUDirect RDMA) on GB300: needle prompts at 4.5k / 11k / 40k and greedy 24k / 40k / 86k / 300k / 763k-token prompts return the expected key with text matching the Mooncake-free aggregated run; a six-rung real-trace replay (300 s per rung, ISL median 6.7k, p90 127k) completed 100% of requests at every rung; the same configuration has served shadow production traffic for three days. Not exercised: NIXL with DP attention, and NIXL host staging (not in main).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No kernel or scheduling change; the gate only decides whether the deployment starts.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+        # The DSpark aux (first token, draft state, hidden states) travels on the
+        # prefill-side aux WRITE path that disaggregation/common implements for
+        # every transfer backend, so NIXL carries it the same way Mooncake does.

             read_ragged_verify_mode() is not RaggedVerifyMode.STATIC
-            or cfg.disaggregation_transfer_backend != "mooncake"

-                "and CP=1 on both servers. DP attention is supported when "
+                "DeepSeek-V4.1 DSpark PD requires static verify, Mooncake or "
+                "NIXL, and CP=1 on both servers. DP attention is supported when "
                 "both servers use the same block size and target/draft KV layout."
             )

@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+"""DeepSeek-V4.1 DSpark PD admits the NIXL transfer backend alongside Mooncake."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.deepseek_v4_hook import validate_deepseek_v41_features
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config import (
+    Backend,
+    CudaGraphConfig,
+    PhaseConfig,
+)
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.srt.speculative.ragged_verify import RaggedVerifyMode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE = "sglang.srt.speculative.ragged_verify.read_ragged_verify_mode"
+
+
+def _pd_args(**overrides):
+    args = ServerArgs(
+        **{
+            "model_path": "local-deepseek-v41",
+            "attention_backend": "dsv4",
+            "speculative_algorithm": "DSPARK",
+            "disaggregation_mode": "prefill",
+            "disaggregation_transfer_backend": "mooncake",
+            "cuda_graph_config": CudaGraphConfig(
+                prefill=PhaseConfig(backend=Backend.DISABLED)
+            ),
+            **overrides,
+        }
+    )
+    args._model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        hf_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            architectures=["DeepseekV4ForCausalLM"], model_type="deepseek_v41"
+        ),
+        hf_text_config=SimpleNamespace(model_type="deepseek_v41"),
+        is_multimodal=False,
+    )
+    return args
+
+
+class TestDSV41DSparkPDTransport(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_nixl_and_mooncake_are_admitted(self):
+        for backend in ("mooncake", "nixl"):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(backend=backend),
+                mock.patch(_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE, return_value=RaggedVerifyMode.STATIC),
+            ):
+                validate_deepseek_v41_features(
+                    _pd_args(disaggregation_transfer_backend=backend)
+                )
+
+    def test_other_transports_are_rejected(self):
+        with mock.patch(_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE, return_value=RaggedVerifyMode.STATIC):
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Mooncake or NIXL"):
+                validate_deepseek_v41_features(
+                    _pd_args(disaggregation_transfer_backend="fake")
+                )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
